name: broll-cutaways
title: B-roll cutaways
line: Your own B-roll cut in on the words that name it while your voice runs on: full screen, split with you, or you in a corner
card: Your footage cut in on the words
say: cut to my b-roll when I mention it
show my clips while I talk
b-roll on top and me below
put me in a corner over my b-roll
cut to the lake when I say lake

askeditor.what: Cut my B-roll in where I name each thing
askeditor.why: swap a clip, move a cutaway or change the layout on the timeline without rendering again
